Option 3: "صاحب خبر بیامد و من بی خبر شدم - گوشم به راه تا که خبر می دهد ز دوست". "The bearer of news came and I became unaware? My ear is on the way until it gives news from a friend." Might be about listening, receiving news.

Option 4: "گویی کز این جهان به جهان دگر شدم - از در درآمدی و من از خودبه درشدم". "As if I became from this world to another world - you entered the door and I from myself entered the door." Might be about transcendence.
